title: Placeholder Asset Generation
intent: Generate tiny placeholder PNGs and manifest JSON files for Verdant and village tileset.
acceptance: assets/characters/verdant.png and assets/tilesets/village.png are valid PNG files with correct dimensions.
assets/characters/verdant.manifest.json and assets/tilesets/village.manifest.json are valid JSON matching the contract.
scripts/generate-placeholder-assets.ts exists and can regenerate the placeholders.
Verdant image is 32×32 pixels (1 frame). Village tileset is 160×40 pixels (4 tiles at 40×40).

commands.expectedOutput: verdant: verdant character tileset: village tileset
